leach.text: Heinzelman WR, Chandrakasan A, Balakrishnan H. Energy-efficient communication protocol for wireless microsensor networks. Proceedings of the 33rd Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences. 2000.
leach.supports: Classical probabilistic head rotation and first-order radio modelling; not the randomized control implemented here.

etx.text: De Couto DSJ, Aguayo D, Bicket J, Morris R. A high-throughput path metric for multi-hop wireless routing. Proceedings of MobiCom. 2003:134-146.
etx.supports: Expected transmission count as a path-quality metric; distinguishes ETX from capped observed transaction cost.

rpl.text: Winter T, Thubert P, Brandt A, Hui J, Kelsey R, Levis P, et al. RPL: IPv6 Routing Protocol for Low-Power and Lossy Networks. RFC 6550. Internet Engineering Task Force; 2012.
rpl.supports: Standardized routing in low-power and lossy networks; no claim that this simulator implements RPL.

kundu.text: Kundu M, Kanjilal R, Uysal I. Intelligent clustering and adaptive energy management in wireless sensor networks with KDE-based deployment. Sensors. 2025;25(8):2588.
kundu.supports: KDE deployment, adaptive clustering and Bayesian energy-uncertainty modelling are prior work.

dhaka.text: Dhaka RS, Khurana M, Lamba S, Sharma AK. Energy-lifetime aware cluster head selection in wireless sensor networks using an adaptive hybrid GWO-PSO framework. Discover Computing. 2026;29:406.
dhaka.supports: Recent joint clustering/routing optimization with energy-lifetime objectives.

rplhybrid.text: Counassegarane T, Punniakodi S. Learning automata and firefly algorithm based RPL for dynamic Internet of Things networks. Discover Computing. 2026;29:237.
rplhybrid.supports: Dynamic parent selection and metaheuristic refinement evaluated in Cooja.

qpsodrl.text: Guangjie L. QPSODRL: an improved quantum particle swarm optimization and deep reinforcement learning based intelligent clustering and routing protocol for wireless sensor networks. Scientific Reports. 2026;16:5526.
qpsodrl.supports: Prior integration of QPSO clustering and reinforcement-learning routing; not reproduced as a baseline.

gentle.text: Angelopoulos AN, Bates S. Conformal prediction: a gentle introduction. Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning. 2023;16(4):494-591.
gentle.supports: Residual calibration and the assumptions behind conformal prediction.

aci.text: Gibbs I, Candès EJ. Adaptive conformal inference under distribution shift. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems. 2021;34:1660-1672.
aci.supports: Online adjustment of the nominal miscoverage parameter; its original guarantee is not attributed to the clipped batch update used here.

barber.text: Barber RF, Candès EJ, Ramdas A, Tibshirani RJ. Conformal prediction beyond exchangeability. Annals of Statistics. 2023;51(2):816-845.
barber.supports: Exchangeability violations, weighting and distribution drift.

strong.text: Bhatnagar A, Wang H, Xiong C, Bai Y. Improved online conformal prediction via strongly adaptive online learning. Proceedings of Machine Learning Research. 2023;202:2337-2363.
strong.supports: Local-interval coverage/regret objectives under changing distributions.

aci2024.text: Gibbs I, Candès EJ. Conformal inference for online prediction with arbitrary distribution shifts. Journal of Machine Learning Research. 2024;25(162):1-36.
aci2024.supports: Adaptive step-size selection and local guarantees beyond basic ACI.

wirelesscp.text: Cohen KM, Park S, Simeone O, Shamai S. Calibrating AI models for wireless communications via conformal prediction. IEEE Transactions on Machine Learning in Communications and Networking. 2023;1:296-312.
wirelesscp.supports: Conformal prediction in demodulation, modulation classification and channel prediction.

contextcp.text: Yoo S, Park S, Popovski P, Kang J, Simeone O. Calibrating wireless AI via meta-learned context-dependent conformal prediction. IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing. 2026;74:423-438.
contextcp.supports: Calibration-test mismatch and context-dependent weighted conformal prediction in wireless AI.

feedback.text: Fannjiang C, Bates S, Angelopoulos AN, Listgarten J, Jordan MI. Conformal prediction under feedback covariate shift for biomolecular design. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA. 2022;119(43):e2204569119.
feedback.supports: Decision-induced calibration/test dependence as a statistical issue; no claim that its estimator is implemented here.

riskcontrol.text: Angelopoulos AN, Bates S, Fisch A, Lei L, Schuster T. Conformal risk control. Proceedings of the International Conference on Learning Representations. 2024.
riskcontrol.supports: Loss-level risk control differs from marginal prediction coverage.

cvar.text: Rockafellar RT, Uryasev S. Optimization of conditional value-at-risk. Journal of Risk. 2000;2(3):21-41.
cvar.supports: Expected-shortfall objective; used here for an empirical surrogate distribution only.

holm.text: Holm S. A simple sequentially rejective multiple test procedure. Scandinavian Journal of Statistics. 1979;6(2):65-70.
holm.supports: Family-wise multiplicity correction for the prespecified test families.
